**Shapley Value Allocation**

The Shapley value is a solution concept in game theory that aims to fairly allocate a set of goods or resources among multiple individuals. It takes into account all possible permutations of the order in which the goods are allocated and calculates the average contribution of each individual to the total value of the allocation.
